title: Pullback of the normalized positive Kummer transpose
statement: Fix ell,E, schemes X,Y, a morphism f:X -> Y, normalized Chern data cY,cX [def-sp-tower-class-chern], and intermediate coefficient pullback data d [def-sp-tower-chern-pullback-intermediate]. Let tY,tX be the adjunction transposes of cY.rootIso.hom and cX.rootIso.hom [def-sp-tower-class-reduction], and let b be the derived forgetful-square isomorphism. Then F(tY) followed by b on the shifted root and U_X((d.derivedRoot 2).hom) equals unitsDerivedPull(f) followed by tX [lem-sp-tower-integral-class-pullback]. The full degree-two shift and all single-complex comparisons are included.

theorem kummer_pullback_transpose
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    {cY : Chern l E Y} {cX : Chern l E X}
    (nY : cY.Normalized l E) (nX : cX.Normalized l E)
    (d : IntegralCoefficientPullback l E f cY cX) :
    (abPull f).mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((cY.reduction.derivedAdjunction.homEquiv _ _) cY.rootIso.hom) ≫
      (Functor.mapDerivedCategorySquareIso d.forgetIso).hom.app
        (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Systems Y (Rrings l Y)) 0).obj
          cY.rootModule)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧) ≫
      cX.reduction.forget.F.mapDerivedCategory.map (d.derivedRoot 2).hom =
    unitsDerivedPull f ≫
      (cX.reduction.derivedAdjunction.homEquiv _ _) cX.rootIso.hom
